# UXAbility

> UXAbility is a web audit application for performance, accessibility, SEO, Answer Engine Optimization, privacy, carbon footprint, and AI bot policy checks.

## Primary Pages

- Home and audit tool: https://uxability.vercel.app/

## Capabilities

- Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse-style diagnostics
- Accessibility, SEO, and best-practice scoring
- AEO and AI readability signals
- Privacy and third-party tracker analysis
- robots.txt and AI crawler policy analysis
- PDF report export

## Crawling Guidance

AI answer engines may crawl and cite the public UXAbility homepage. API endpoints under `/api/` are not intended as citation sources.
